confirmedFindings.title: Routed DTO disagrees with summary metadata and distinct-field assumptions
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Handler sends now/window_start and optional last_seen_at/freshness_seconds, not generated_at or unique_fields. Typed request is a cast, not DTO validation, and camelCaseKeys cannot invent different semantic fields. Summary therefore omits server freshness/evidence, declares exact bounds not supplied despite supplied window_start/now metadata, and renders unknown distinct fields even with field rows. Page header freshness measures query receipt, not signal freshness.
confirmedFindings.repro: Source trace of any successful payload constructed by the routed handler: generated_at and unique_fields are absent; generated_at freshness condition is false, rawValue unique_fields is undefined and the unconditional boundsUnknown text remains. No payload was requested or rendered.
confirmedFindings.fix: Assign existing typed DTO/hook/domain summary integration owners to preserve and display actual server metadata; decide a truthful full distinct-field contract without deriving completeness from the capped rows.
confirmedFindings.historicalRelation: Still present from audit-page-017 architecture wire-contract finding; not a new cosmetic rewrite.

confirmedFindings.title: Total samples is a capped-field subtotal labelled as the whole-window total
confirmedFindings.mechanism: FieldStats LIMIT applies before handler summation. Page limit is 100; total_samples sums only returned field rows. Bucket query does not apply that limit, while the summary says Total samples within selected window.
confirmedFindings.repro: Synthetic arithmetic witness: 101 distinct fields each containing one sample would return 100 field rows and total_samples=100, while all-field bucket counts sum to 101. This is a source-derived counterexample, not an executed database test.
confirmedFindings.fix: Expose a full aggregate or explicit subtotal/truncation semantics through the existing backend contract and corresponding summary; do not silently invent complete totals or widen the page cap.
confirmedFindings.historicalRelation: Still present from audit-page-017 aggregate-scope finding.

confirmedFindings.title: Mobile field Kind and its header sort/filter controls are hidden without a detail replacement
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Explicit mobileColumns omits value_kind. Shared table applies hidden md:table-cell to both excluded cells and headers. Caller supplies no mobilePresentation, expandable detail or alternate Kind display. Column persistence cannot override the separate mobile allow-list.
confirmedFindings.repro: Source-derived below-md branch for a field row with any Kind: its cell and header carry hidden; the existing caller offers no visible detail replacement. A Kind filter set on desktop can remain active while its own clearing header is hidden on mobile. Native viewport/control reachability was not exercised.
confirmedFindings.fix: Use the existing complete mobile detail/presentation capability or retain the fourth column in the bounded accessible table. Preserve sort/filter/pagination/tableId and preferences.
confirmedFindings.historicalRelation: Still present from audit-page-017 mobile-information finding.

confirmedFindings.title: Fleet loading, failure and paused states collapse to no vehicle selected
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Selector keeps only fleet data and returns vehicles ?? []; no fleet state/error/retry reaches the page. With neither URL nor persisted ID and undefined fleet data, effective selection is null. Page disables ingest, renders Select a vehicle, and suppresses its sole source descriptor; it cannot explain or retry the failed prerequisite.
confirmedFindings.repro: Source trace with URL/store selection absent and initial fleet query pending, paused or failed without data: all three map to empty options/no selection. The UI cannot distinguish these from a successfully empty fleet. No request was made.
confirmedFindings.fix: Reuse an agreed existing fleet query/source descriptor through the selector and register it independently; keep global URL/store selection behavior unchanged.
confirmedFindings.historicalRelation: Still present from audit-page-017 independent-fleet-source finding.

confirmedFindings.title: Defensive malformed-count paths turn unknown into measured zero
confirmedFindings.mechanism: safeNumber(null/undefined/nonfinite) returns 0. Ranked list passes this fabricated reading and fmtInt(0) into MetricBar, defeating its existing unknown-reading branch. Table fmtInt directly shares the same zero coercion. Chart fallback data columns instead return an em dash for nonnumeric input.
confirmedFindings.repro: Source-derived synthetic malformed row with sample_count=null: ranked bar receives numeric 0 and readout 0; table renders 0, although MetricBar(null) would omit aria-valuenow and label No reading.
confirmedFindings.reproStatus: SOURCE_PROVEN defensive-path defect only; normal routed COUNT(*) DTO is nonnullable. No claim that a deployed null count was observed.
confirmedFindings.fix: Keep malformed readings unknown through ranking/display; pass null to MetricBar and an em dash to table/labels. Preserve actual zero and rank only valid counts.
confirmedFindings.historicalRelation: Ranked-list issue still present from audit-page-017; table formatter mechanism was directly inspected here.

confirmedFindings.title: Loaded-row search/value-filter no-match reports no samples in the selected window
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Caller always supplies No samples in this window for settled state. Shared table uses the same emptyMessage when filteredData becomes empty, even if supplied data remains nonempty. Search can hide all rows while chart/summary still show samples; value-filter matching count is separate and does not replace the contradictory message.
confirmedFindings.repro: Source-derived loaded-row scenario: nonempty fields plus a search term matching no column text produces filteredData.length=0, rendering No samples in this window instead of No fields match these filters. No interaction was executed.
confirmedFindings.fix: Reuse existing table/page filter-state APIs to distinguish filtered no-match from successful empty source, with a clear-filter recovery action and preserved loaded-row search scope.

confirmedFindings.title: Twenty finite duration translation keys are absent from canonical English
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Finite expanded admin.xray.windowOption/windowLabel keys for five windows and bucketOption/bucketLabel keys for five buckets are absent from canonical en.json. Summary fallback durations therefore have no canonical localized counterparts. formatValueKind also supplies the unlocalized human fallback kind N directly to badge/filter labels; raw type names are not classified as mistranslated data.
confirmedFindings.repro: Executed read-only canonical lookup checked 68 unique keys: 48 present, 20 absent. Static t expressions select the listed missing keys for the declared duration enums. No browser language switch or catalog generation ran.
confirmedFindings.reproStatus: EXECUTED source/catalog lookup; localized runtime NOTRUN
confirmedFindings.fix: Catalog integration owner should add only these known finite keys through the normal canonical/split workflow and localize the human kind fallback without changing raw kind identity. No catalog edit was made here.

candidates.observation: Mean divides by returned nonempty bucket count, not full-window intervals; SQL has no gap-fill. For one populated bucket containing 60 samples it displays 60 regardless of quiet buckets.
candidates.whyCandidate: Arithmetic is source-established, but existing tests explicitly expect mean of supplied buckets and the label does not establish a contractual zero-filled denominator. Decide observed-bucket versus full-window meaning before changing behavior; no invented bounds.

candidates.observation: Both queries use ts >= windowStart without an upper timestamp; future-dated rows could enter a nominal rolling window. Three scans are not a shared database snapshot.
candidates.whyCandidate: SQL shape is proven, but admissibility of future timestamps and deployed effects were not traced or exercised; no actual ingest payload was inspected. Integration owner must establish expected bound/snapshot semantics.

candidates.observation: An initially paused query with no data has DataState initial and query isLoading false, so brief may show loading while chart/table use empty placeholders; a page source notice correctly identifies paused offline. Aged query isStale alone does not set summary retained without maxAgeMs.

candidates.observation: Kind is MAX(value_kind) over the field's window, not the latest sample's kind.
candidates.whyCandidate: Current column label only says Kind, not latest kind. Preserve actual aggregation semantics and clarify operator interpretation; do not change to latest without an agreed contract.
